Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Subject: Jiexiu Xianshen Tower 介休祆神楼, the actual COMPOUND GATE/THEATRE/STREET-PASSAGE TOWER in images2and3. Image2 is the preferred near-frontal, slightly oblique full shape; image3 supplies clearer structural details from a stronger oblique angle. Keep the image2 viewpoint. This is a contiguous T-shaped, multi-roof COMPOSITE building, not a symmetrical standalone pagoda. Its left/front projecting square street-passage pavilion connects continuously into the wider, set-back theatre mass on the right. Preserve TWO separate top gables visible side by side, the taller hipped-gable crowns, the smaller gable over the projecting front balcony, the interlaced upward-sweeping eave corners, and all four apparent levels of eave/balcony lines as actually visible in image2. Keep the conspicuous low uninterrupted sweeping roof in front, raised on tall slender round columns with three open passage bays below it; these pillars have modest cylindrical stone bases on a low plinth. Upper windows and balcony openings remain white rectangles, outlined with selective lattice strokes. The wider right/rear mass has its own stacked eave lines and a ground-level plain brick wall, connected at the inner corner. Preserve the asymmetrical compound outline, no invented left wing or extra tower. Reduce foreshortening very slightly but do not flatten the connected parts into a generic temple front. Keep tiny outlines suggesting ridge-end beasts, finials, hanging corner bells and bracket clusters; simplify repetitive bracket and tile detail to about20% of the photographed density. Roof planes and shaded eave undersides MUST stay broad WHITE areas, with only a handful of long faint tile-guiding strokes; never black fills, hatch shadows, dense brick grids or full tile nets. No text on plaques or banners. Remove modern buildings behind, lower-right neighboring green-roof hall that obscures the tower, modern signs, tourists, motorcycles, parked cars, utility cables, chains, fences, and foreground lion statues. Do not add symmetrical stairs; retain a few short low platform outlines as seen. historical_sources.title: 从历代《介休方志》看祆神楼与三结义庙的“前世今生”
historical_sources.publisher: 国家图书馆《文津流觞》第63期，赵依澍，2018
historical_sources.evidence: 依据县志及现场调研辨析：现见祆神楼与三结义庙为清代重建重修，顺治十六年（1659）火灾后于1660—1668年间重建，清中期再修。文章区分明嘉靖改祀与清代重建，指出把改建年记为万历有误。建筑平面呈凸字形，前部过街楼与后部山门、戏楼相连。

historical_sources.title: 祆神楼
historical_sources.publisher: 维基百科（辅助定位及题记记录，不作为主要断代依据）
historical_sources.evidence: 提供建筑坐标；引《山西古建筑地图》等记载乐楼琉璃脊题记康熙六年（1667）。本条保守采用国家图书馆实地研究给出的清初重建范围，不直接采创建传说年代。

site_recommendation.name: 介休祆神楼
site_recommendation.sub: 过街楼与乐楼 · 复合楼阁
site_recommendation.era: 清 · 顺治末至康熙初
site_recommendation.yearNote: 时间轴1664仅为1660—1668重建范围的约略中点；不作为确切建造年份。现存主体依国家图书馆实地研究定为清初重建，勿用宋代创建传说或明代改祀年着色。
site_recommendation.lede: 街道从楼下穿过，戏台在门楼上展开。祆神楼把不同用途叠进相连的楼阁，琉璃重檐与山花交错，勾出介休城里特别的天际线。

facts.label: 清初重建
facts.text: 现存楼阁为顺治末至康熙初重建，后来又经修缮；楼名与早期祆神信仰的历史，不等同于现存木构年代。

facts.label: 三者合一
facts.text: 过街楼、山门与乐楼组成凸字形建筑，前部通行、后部入庙，上层兼作戏台。

facts.label: 重檐交错
facts.text: 相接的歇山屋顶、突出山花与层层挑檐形成复合轮廓，琉璃脊饰和木构铺作彼此映衬。
